Custom Analyzers

Integrating custom Roslyn analyzers with RoselineMCP.

Overview

RoselineMCP automatically discovers and uses any Roslyn-based analyzers installed in your projects.

Adding Analyzers

Via NuGet Package

Add analyzer packages to your .csproj:

<ItemGroup>
  <!-- Microsoft Analyzers -->
  <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers" Version="8.0.0" />
  
  <!-- Roslynator -->
  <PackageReference Include="Roslynator.Analyzers" Version="4.14.0" />
  
  <!-- StyleCop -->
  <PackageReference Include="StyleCop.Analyzers" Version="1.2.0" />
  
  <!-- Custom Analyzer -->
  <PackageReference Include="YourCustom.Analyzers" Version="1.0.0" />
</ItemGroup>

Via Project Reference

<ItemGroup>
  <ProjectReference Include="../CustomAnalyzer/CustomAnalyzer.csproj"
                    OutputItemType="Analyzer" />
</ItemGroup>

Creating Custom Analyzers

Basic Analyzer Structure

[DiagnosticAnalyzer(LanguageNames.CSharp)]
public class MyCustomAnalyzer : DiagnosticAnalyzer
{
    public const string DiagnosticId = "CUSTOM001";
    
    private static readonly DiagnosticDescriptor Rule = new(
        DiagnosticId,
        "Title",
        "Message format",
        "Category",
        DiagnosticSeverity.Warning,
        isEnabledByDefault: true);
    
    public override ImmutableArray<DiagnosticDescriptor> SupportedDiagnostics
        => ImmutableArray.Create(Rule);
    
    public override void Initialize(AnalysisContext context)
    {
        // Register analysis actions
    }
}

With Code Fix Provider

[ExportCodeFixProvider(LanguageNames.CSharp)]
public class MyCustomCodeFixProvider : CodeFixProvider
{
    public override ImmutableArray<string> FixableDiagnosticIds
        => ImmutableArray.Create("CUSTOM001");
    
    public override async Task RegisterCodeFixesAsync(CodeFixContext context)
    {
        // Register code fixes
    }
}

Testing Custom Analyzers

  1. Add analyzer to project
  2. Run listDiagnostics to verify detection
  3. Check if ID appears in results
  4. Test fixes with applyFixes

Popular Analyzer Packages

Package Focus Diagnostic Prefix
Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers .NET best practices CA
Roslynator.Analyzers Code quality RCS
StyleCop.Analyzers Code style SA
SonarAnalyzer.CSharp Security & quality S
Meziantou.Analyzer Performance MA

Configuration

.editorconfig

Configure analyzer severity:

[*.cs]
# Custom analyzer rules
dotnet_diagnostic.CUSTOM001.severity = warning
dotnet_diagnostic.CA1001.severity = error

Suppression

Suppress specific diagnostics:

#pragma warning disable CUSTOM001
// Code here
#pragma warning restore CUSTOM001
